Network Engineer at Leidos

Location: Aurora, CO (Hybrid)
Clearance: TS/SCI with CI Polygraph required
Salary: $135,000 - $165,000

Job ID: R-00098765

We are seeking a Network Engineer to support a critical DoD mission. You will design,
configure, and maintain secure LAN/WAN infrastructure: Cisco routing and switching, VLANs,
VPNs, and firewalls. Harden systems under STIG and RMF, and automate network operations with
Python and Bash scripting. DevSecOps mindset. AI/ML exposure a plus.

Required: TS/SCI w/ poly, Cisco, network engineering, Python, firewalls, VPN.
